Name: XdrLogRaider
Author: Alex Kefallonitis - al.kefallonitis@gmail.com
Description: Open-source Microsoft Sentinel data connector for Microsoft Defender XDR portal-internal `/apiproxy/*` audit and reporting endpoints. Ingests Defender XDR events into per-Category custom Log Analytics tables (`Defender_<Category>_CL`) with one typed row per event, raw JSON preserved, and dynamic per-tenant capability discovery. Additional Categories activate via manifest entries without operator action.
Description2: Runs entirely inside your Azure subscription as a self-hosted PowerShell Function App. Service account cookie + transparent SSO refresh (TOTP or Passkey MFA). Zero telemetry to the maintainer. Read-only by design — no action verbs ever invoked on the Defender portal.
Data Connectors Description: Defender XDR portal-internal `/apiproxy/*` connector · cookie-based authentication with transparent SSO refresh · per-Category typed schema
